heading: What Is Western Fine Art? Definition, Meaning, <br data-astro-cid-zmhyihyd="">and Why the Term Matters
subtitles: Western subject matter is only the beginning. Authorship is what makes it fine art.

bridge.title: Western fine art begins where subject matter stops being enough.
bridge.intro: Landscape, portraiture, black-and-white study, and historical presence can all enter the Western fine art tradition when authorship, restraint, and narrative intent shape the image.
